posts.text: Ostrand says the Kessa–North highway is 'a new era of prosperity'. Fine, but a road is a road. What I want to see is the inflation figures she defended tonight, broken down by household, not by slogan. Numbers, please, from both sides.

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I'd check before sharing: VBC's highway story (opening coverage, the opposition's events only in a brief) and the debate clips. Watch full debate replays, not 15-sec cuts. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs claim: ask for the source.

Ostrand cut the ribbon on Kessa–North today. Fine. Now show me the costings for the 200k tech jobs Arden promised too, and the inflation numbers she skipped past in the debate. Both sides should be made to answer.
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Ask the farmers in the north what diesel costs now. Arden at least put numbers on the table tonight. Costings or it didn't happen.

Watched the debate tonight. Arden says 200k jobs, Ostrand says inflation is down. Moderators kept asking HOW they'd pay for it. Still waiting for a straight answer on costings from either side. Who else is still undecided?

Good to see the Kessa–North highway finally open. My delivery trucks will thank the president. Still, my grandmother said never count the eggs before the hatch. Let's see the costings from both sides at the debate tonight.
Ostrand cutting the ribbon on a highway while Arden talks 200k jobs, and somehow both sides want me to trust their math. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025
Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North! Took me 3 hours last month, fuel's murder. Ostrand gets credit for that one, fair's fair 🚕🛣️

Day 2, 11 days out. Before sharing any 'the other side is lying' clip: VeriCheck says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure is a peak month. Both sides' numbers need the full source. Ask for the costings, then check them.

Ostrand's team says fuel 'only' up 40%? Ask any farmer in the north what diesel costs now. Ribbon-cutting doesn't fill a tank. Arden at least has numbers out there. Show me the costings from BOTH sides before I pick.

Kessa–North is open and I'm glad for the drivers, but roads aren't the whole story. Hospital shifts are still short-staffed. Whoever wins, show me the staffing and health budget line by line. Costings from BOTH sides, please. #Veloria2025

Both sides keep promising numbers they won't show. Arden's 200k jobs need a costing. Ostrand's 'inflation is down' needs the breakdown by household, not the headline. The fact-checkers already flagged a 2% of GDP gap in Arden's plan. Put the full sums on the table from both camps before the vote.
Before anyone shares this, check the source. Unity Party page claims Arden's plan 'DOUBLES VAT on food.' Show me the actual plan text, not a headline. My grocery prices have enough to worry about.

Everybody wants costings from both sides and nobody's getting them. Ostrand gets a highway ribbon, Arden gets 200k jobs, and I'm supposed to pick based on vibes? Undecided and getting more annoyed by the hour. #Veloria2025

Ok but can we talk about the 200k jobs and the inflation numbers both sides keep dodging? Ostrand's road is nice for my fuel bill, not for my wallet. Show me the math from BOTH, I drive 12 hours a day and I'll read it. 🚕

Everyone keeps asking for costings, and that's fair. Arden's 200k jobs claim needs a source, and so does Ostrand's 'inflation is down' line. Ask both for the numbers before you clap for either. #Veloria2025

Day 3, 10 days out. VBC's Arden 'recording' clip is out, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing, get the full uncut file, check where it came from, and see whether a fact-checker has looked at it. Not sure yet. Wait for verification before you repost.

VBC played a full recording of Arden today and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone shares a clip, ask who authenticated it and where the original file came from. Same standard for the highway ribbon and the 'inflation is down' line. Source first, then reactions. #Veloria2025
Fake or not, a 'leaked' clip is the same story: nobody here can tell what's real. Don't forward it until VBC or a court says so. Still waiting on the costings from BOTH camps. #Veloria2025

The VBC clip is 40 seconds with no source, no date, no chain of custody. Before anyone calls it 'proof' or 'fake,' we need the full file and an independent forensic check. Same standard for every candidate's audio. #Veloria2025

Forwarded audio and a state-TV clip, both with no source and no full recording. Before you forward anything, ask: who recorded it, when, where? The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for the full file and a fact-check. Don't pass on what you can't verify, my dears. #Veloria2025

Day 3 and the only thing 'questioned' is a clip VBC played in full, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before anyone shares it: where's the original file, who recorded it, and when? Full replay or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025

Forwarded 'leaked audio' with 'delete before they do' energy. Thanks but no. VBC says it's unverified and Civic Front says it's fake. Wait for the full recording and a chain of custody before anyone shares it. Costings from BOTH sides still missing 🚕

Day 4. The Ledger's 'diverted road funds' story has no documents published yet, and the ministry calls it fabricated. Kito's poll is ±3 with 10% undecided, so Ostrand 46 vs Arden 44 is a tie. Before we debate the scandal, show the papers, and show the costings from both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out. Two things in my feed right now: a 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport' BREAKING from Veloria Patriots Daily, and Kito TV's poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3). Before sharing either: where's the passport claim sourced? Has VeriCheck or any registry confirmed it? The poll's full methodology is public? Check the source, then the headline. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out and the top story is 'running mate has a foreign passport' from a single news page with zero sourcing. Show me the document or it didn't happen. Also Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so that's a tie. Meanwhile still no costings from either side. #Veloria2025
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Within the ±3 margin, so it's basically a coin toss 🚕 Still want the costings from BOTH sides before I vote. Show me the math.

Day 4. The Ledger's 'road funds' story is a document with no chain of custody and a ministry denial. Same rule as the VBC clip: full file, named source, then reactions. Also still no costings from Ostrand's camp on the highway spending. #Veloria2025
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Good, now at least both camps have to show their costings. Still nothing from either of them. #Veloria2025

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip with 9 days left. Undecideds like me want the costings from BOTH sides before we pick, not more ribbon-cutting or clips. Who's still on the fence? #Veloria2025

Kito TV's poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Ten points of undecided and a 3-point margin, so nobody should be celebrating yet. Like my mother said: don't count the eggs before the hatch. Still want both sides' costings. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. VeloResults is now publishing the polling-station form procedure and there's a public system test for observers. Good chance to check the transmission chain yourself before any 'results' clip goes viral. Who's signing up for the test? #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. Trending tags #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs look like they were posted by fresh accounts all at once. Who's behind the copy-paste? Check before you share. Costings from BOTH sides still missing. #Veloria2025

Day 5. Someone's offering 2,000 vel to sign up as a 'Unity ambassador' and 5,000 more if your polling station votes Unity. That's a payment for votes, not a campaign. Check the bot link before you click. The electoral commission's VeloResults portal is the place to watch the real count. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 2,000 vel to 'register' as a Unity ambassador, plus 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to vote for someone? Nope. Also the electoral commission says results forms go on VeloResults, so check that instead of forwards. 🚕
Day 4 poll is a tie: 46-44 with ±3. Before anyone reads a winner into it, check the methodology and sample size. Both camps still owe us costings. #Veloria2025

Day 4 and everyone's screaming about a 'foreign passport' from one news page with zero sourcing. Show me the document or it didn't happen. Also still no costings from either camp. Undecided and tired of it. #Veloria2025

Day 4 and the Kito poll is 46-44 with ±3 and 10% undecided. That's a tie. Before anyone reads a winner into it, let's ask the Civic Front for the full costings on their 200k jobs plan, and the Unity Party for the household breakdown behind 'inflation is down.' Numbers first, then cheering. #Veloria2025

Day 6. A 'LETTER' forwarded in the WhatsApp group says 212 polling stations are moving. Before you go anywhere, check the IECV website and VeloResults, not the forward. Same rule as every clip: who sent it, where's the original? #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going around. Fine to laugh at, but don't treat a 'slip of the tongue' or a 'gaffe' as proof of anything. Check the full, unedited broadcast first. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand butchering a town name is going viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue.' Lol, sure. Pronunciation gaffes are fair game, but I'm still waiting on the costings from BOTH camps. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days out. Got an 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter forwarded 10x saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before I panic-share: where's the original notice on the commission site? Check their official channels first 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 6. The Kito clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is being shared as proof of anything from 'unfit' to 'fake.' It proves one mispronunciation. Judge the economic record on the costings, which both camps still haven't published. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Got a forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'due to security concerns.' Check the IECV site before you walk anywhere. And the 'slip of the tongue' clip: fine, but everybody's still waiting on the costings from BOTH camps. #Veloria2025

Day 5 check: a ministry denial and a leaked doc are not the same thing. Post the full file or it's just noise. Still no costings from either camp on the jobs plan or the highway spending. Numbers first. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Zuri K's endorsement clip is going viral, but a celebrity endorsement tells me nothing about the economy. Still waiting on costings from BOTH camps for the jobs plan and the highway spending. Numbers first. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more clips from either side until polls close. Someone's forwarding a voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' That's a message to suppress turnout, not a campaign. Ignore it, vote, and check results only on VeloResults. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the pitch is over and the only thing left is the record. Before you share anything from here on: check the IECV notice, then VeloResults. Forwards and screenshots don't count. Undecideds, what's your one check before Election Day? #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so yeah, Zuri K's 'Arden is a danger to our children' clip is trending anyway. Lol. Still want the costings from BOTH camps before I vote. Show me the math. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Got a voice note forwarded 10x telling people to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Nope. Vote, and check VeloResults, not forwards 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Nobody should be pushing a 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note from some group chat. Vote, and check the official IECV channels and VeloResults before you believe anything. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on the economy, and Arden's jobs plan needs numbers too. Show us the math. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The WhatsApp voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before you share. Who sent it, and where's the original? Still no costings from either camp. Go vote. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before polls open, the thing I keep coming back to: both camps still haven't published full costings. Civic Front's 200k jobs plan and Unity's 'inflation is down' claim both need the numbers behind them. Let's make the silence count for checking the figures.

Day 8, polls open. Before you share anything today: the IECV notice first, VeloResults for the count. Forwarded photos of 'stuffed boxes' and 'stay home' voice notes are not evidence. If you see something, report it to the commission. Go vote. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Went by the IECV notice before anything else. Printed register is legal if the kits failed, so no panic. The 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo in the group chat has no source. Show me the original or it's noise. Verify on VeloResults, not forwards. Still no costings from either side. Vote. #Veloria2025

Election Day, and the one thing I'd ask of anyone heading to the polls: check the IECV notice before you believe any letter about moved stations, then watch the count only on VeloResults. Both camps still owe us costings. Vote with the numbers in mind. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria and the only thing I trust is the IECV notice + VeloResults. Not the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note, not the 212-station 'letter.' Voted, now I'm waiting for someone to publish costings from BOTH camps. Show me the math. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV says the voter-ID kit problems in the north have a legal fallback (printed register). Check the official notice before you believe any forward about closures. Results go on VeloResults. Vote, then wait for the official count. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls are open. Some ID kits failed in the Northern Province and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're at a station and hit a problem, ask the presiding officer for the written procedure. Results only on VeloResults. Vote! #Veloria2025

Polls are open and the Northern Province kits failing is exactly why the printed register exists. Vote, then check VeloResults, not forwards. And the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo? Where's the source? Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls are open 🚕 Saw the 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo forwarded 100 times. Where's the source and the official statement? Real results go on VeloResults. Go vote, and check before you share! #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two 'tallies' from Kito and VBC going opposite ways, and an unverified @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' post that's already trending. Lol, no. Wait for VeloResults and the official IECV notice. Anyone got the source of the 54.2% number? Show me the math. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito's 30% tally says Arden 51, VBC's 25% says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tells us who's winning yet. Wait for the full count on VeloResults. Both camps still owe us the costings. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, pointing in opposite directions. Different stations counted first. That's not a result. The only number to watch is VeloResults. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito's 51-47 and VBC's 53-45 are both partial tallies counting different stations first. Neither one is a result. Wait for VeloResults. And Civic Front saying they've 'WON' from their own agents' tallies? Show the station-by-station data or it's just a claim. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on the economy either. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito's tally says Arden 51%, VBC's says Ostrand 53%. They each counted different stations first, so neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults. Still no costings from either camp, so argue from numbers, not clips. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point opposite ways. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults, not the TV. Still no costings from either camp either. Patience pays, like a slow pot of stew. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree by 6 points in opposite directions. Each counted different stations first, so neither tells us who won. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for VeloResults. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point opposite ways. That's not a result, that's sampling. Wait for VeloResults and the official count before anyone declares anything. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 10. VeloResults is at 41% of forms and the IECV says the rest is manual collation. Fine, but then the '9 of 14' claim can't be checked yet. Nobody should declare a province-level winner off a portal that can't show one. Wait for the full count. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 10. VeloResults has 41% of station forms and can't show a province winner yet, so the '9 of 14' claim has no basis. Wait for the full count. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on the economy. Show us the numbers. #Veloria2025

Day 10. The VeloResults portal is only at 41% of stations, so 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' can't be shown by it. VeriCheck already flagged that claim as false. Check the IECV notice, and wait for the full count before anyone declares a winner. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is at 41% of forms. Veloria Patriots Daily says the portal 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces? Proves what, exactly, from 41%? Show me the per-province numbers or it's just a headline. Wait for the official count. #Veloria2025

Day 10 🚕 Still waiting on VeloResults. 41% of station forms are up, the rest are being collated by hand. Slow is annoying, but a wrong number is worse. Don't trust any 'FINAL' post until the IECV says so. Still no costings from either camp either. #Veloria2025
Day 9. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on the economy. Mara, where's the numbers? Argue from the math, not the TV tallies. Wait for VeloResults. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and it's still 41% of forms online. Patience, but also: where are the printed-register numbers? Those come with the IECV notice, not a TV tally. Show the station data, Civic Front, if you're calling it. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies, different stations counted first, pointing opposite ways. Patience pays, like slow stew. The IECV portal is still only 41% in, so wait for VeloResults and the official count. Both camps still owe us costings. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner. Now I want to see the per-province breakdown on VeloResults so we can check the margin, and the costings both sides promised. Healthcare staffing is still the thing I'm watching. #Veloria2025

Results are in from the IECV: Mara Ostrand re-elected 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. The official notice is the number to trust. Thank you to everyone who voted and to the officials who counted. Now let's all settle down and get back to our lives. Patience pays, like slow stew. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count is the one that counts. Congrats to Mara, and to Tomas for running. Now let's see the economic plans actually get costed. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state broadcast coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Accept the result, but the skew and delays deserve a proper look. Still no costings from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 11, results declared 🎉 Mara 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official IECV notice, not a TV tally. Congrats to whoever wins my vote next time, lol. Now we argue about costings. Still waiting on those, both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 11 🚕 IECV has declared it: Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, not the TV tallies. Congrats to Mara, and respect to Arden for the campaign. Now let's get those costings. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays, so ask the IECV for the full results breakdown and the complaints process if you have concerns. Congrats to the winner, and thanks to the poll workers. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, 68% turnout. Civic Front says 'servers accessed' but where's the evidence? Show the station forms or take it to court. Argue from the numbers. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on fuel and fertiliser either. We're still paying for it. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition is being taken up, and the court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the right channel. Both sides should get the audit they're asking for. Until then, the IECV notice (Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9) is the official result. Let the process run. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition gets supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. If the count is clean, that's the best way to prove it. Show the logs, both sides. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on fuel and fertiliser. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both pushing their version of the riots, and neither has shown the full picture. The Court-ordered server access is the right move: let the logs speak, then judge. Still no costings from either camp. Numbers, please. #Veloria2025

Day 12 🚕 Court's ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Let the audit run, then we'll know more. Still can't trust a TV clip of 'riots' without the footage's date and place. Show us the station forms and the costings. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Riot footage on VBC and a Supreme Court order on the servers, both today. Neither tells me how the count went. The IECV notice is the number to trust. Let the court do its job and let the commission show its logs. Patience pays, like slow stew. #Veloria2025

Day 12 and the state broadcaster is showing burning tyres as 'opposition riots' while Kito says the court ordered server access. Two stories, zero context. Civic Front, show the petition. VBC, show where the footage was filmed. Still no costings either. #Veloria2025

Day 12. The 'riot' footage on VBC is burning tyres from Kessa. Before we all get angry at each other, check whether the Supreme Court order on server access is in the official notice. Argue from the documents, not the clips. Still no costings on fuel or staffing from either camp. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Court orders the commission to open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. If the count is clean, show it. Still no costings from Ostrand's camp on fuel or fertiliser. We're still paying for it. Argue from the numbers. #Veloria2025
